RAJESH PAMUJULA

Lead Data Engineer  •  GenAI & Machine Learning  •  Cloud Data Platforms

Hyderabad, India   |   +91 97044 44433   |   raja.pamujula@gmail.com   |   linkedin.com/in/rajeshpamujula

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Lead Data Engineer with 12+ years of global experience designing and scaling cloud-native data platforms, real-time pipelines, and AI-driven solutions across Retail, Logistics, Insurance, and Banking. Deep expertise across the Azure data stack (Databricks, ADF, Snowflake, Unity Catalog) combined with hands-on Generative AI and Machine Learning engineering — leveraging OpenAI/LLMs for automated data quality, synthetic data generation, anomaly detection, and intelligent validation. Proven record of leading engineering teams, optimizing pipeline performance and cost, and translating business goals into reliable, governed, high-impact data products.

AI & GENERATIVE AI HIGHLIGHTS

Built LLM-powered data-quality automation using OpenAI models for intelligent data cleansing, outlier/anomaly detection, and rule-based validation — reducing manual data-prep effort and raising pipeline data accuracy.

Engineered a synthetic data generation framework with LLMs to augment training datasets and accelerate model development while preserving data privacy and compliance.

Delivered GenAI proofs-of-concept for automated data profiling and AI-driven workflow automation, integrating prompt-engineered LLM calls directly into production data pipelines.

Developed and deployed machine learning models (Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy) for forecasting and predictive analytics, and operationalized them within cloud data workflows.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lead Data Engineer  |  Lululemon GCC India	Mar 2022 – Present

Global MarTech — Data-Driven Personalization & Retail Growth

Stack: Python, SQL, PySpark, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Unity Catalog, Kafka, OpenAI/LLMs, ML, Azure

Architected and led a scalable, fault-tolerant Azure data ecosystem integrating multiple sources to power real-time analytics, automated decisioning, and AI-driven personalization across global markets.

Spearheaded GenAI initiatives with OpenAI/LLMs for automated data cleansing, anomaly detection, and intelligent data-quality validation, improving data reliability and reducing manual effort.

Built LLM-based synthetic data generation capabilities to accelerate model development while preserving privacy.

Designed real-time streaming pipelines with Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming for high-throughput ingestion and transformation supporting marketing personalization.

Implemented Unity Catalog governance — lineage, access controls, and compliance — ensuring security and data integrity across the lakehouse.

Optimized Spark/Databricks workloads, tuning compute and storage to cut pipeline latency and cloud cost.

Developed Data-as-a-Service APIs (Python, FastAPI, Azure Functions) enabling secure, real-time, self-service data access.

Led and mentored a team of data engineers, establishing best practices in data architecture, CI/CD, and code quality.

Data Engineer  |  Mphasis Limited	Apr 2019 – Mar 2022

Canadian National Railway — Logistics & Supply-Chain Optimization

Stack: Apache Spark, Python, Scala, Kafka, YARN, Azure ML, ML, On-Prem & Azure

Migrated on-premises data infrastructure to Azure, building an event-driven, microservices-based architecture with Spark, Kafka, and Azure Machine Learning.

Developed ML forecasting models to optimize shipment delivery predictions and improve supply-chain efficiency.

Built scalable Scala/PySpark pipelines on YARN for large-scale batch and streaming processing.

Recognized with the Best Mentor Award (2021) for upskilling team members and raising overall productivity.

Data Engineer  |  Accenture Solutions	Jan 2018 – Apr 2019

Travelers Insurance — Claims Digitalization

Stack: Hadoop, Python, Apache Spark, Hive, Sqoop, ETL

Designed and optimized Spark batch pipelines on Hadoop/Hive to analyze raw claims data and detect fraudulent vs. valid claims.

Built ETL ingestion with Sqoop and Hive supporting claims digitalization, monitoring, and operational support.

Associate Lead Engineer  |  Maveric Systems Limited	Apr 2013 – Jan 2018

Union National Bank (UAE) & SBI General Insurance

Stack: Python, Oracle, Selenium, UFT, JMeter, Java, Maven, DB Testing

Led the T24 core banking upgrade (R07 → R14), ensuring seamless data migration, validation, and reconciliation with minimal business disruption.

Implemented the eBao core insurance solution, introducing automation testing to reduce manual effort and support UAT.

Recognized with the Service Excellence Award (2018) for high-quality delivery and seamless project execution.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages:  Python, SQL, Scala

AI / GenAI / ML:  OpenAI & LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Synthetic Data Generation, Anomaly Detection, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, ML Deployment

Big Data & Streaming:  Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Apache Kafka, Hive, Hadoop, Sqoop

Cloud & Platforms:  Azure (ADF, Azure Functions, Azure ML), Databricks, Unity Catalog, GCP, Cloudera

Data & Warehousing:  Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Hive, Oracle

APIs & DataOps:  FastAPI, Data-as-a-Service, Splunk, CI/CD, Data Governance & Quality Frameworks, Data Profiling, Lineage

CERTIFICATIONS

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate

Generative AI for Data Engineering — Certified

Machine Learning Deployment — iNeuron

EDUCATION

B.Tech, Electrical & Electronics Engineering — JNTU, Hyderabad	2012

Lead Data Engineer  |  Lululemon GCC India	Mar 2022 – Present
Global MarTech — Data-Driven Personalization & Retail Growth
Stack: Python, SQL, PySpark, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Unity Catalog, Kafka, OpenAI/LLMs, ML, Azure
Architected and led a scalable, fault-tolerant Azure data ecosystem integrating multiple sources to power real-time analytics, automated decisioning, and AI-driven personalization across global markets.
Spearheaded GenAI initiatives with OpenAI/LLMs for automated data cleansing, anomaly detection, and intelligent data-quality validation, improving data reliability and reducing manual effort.
Built LLM-based synthetic data generation capabilities to accelerate model development while preserving privacy.
Designed real-time streaming pipelines with Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming for high-throughput ingestion and transformation supporting marketing personalization.
Implemented Unity Catalog governance — lineage, access controls, and compliance — ensuring security and data integrity across the lakehouse.
Optimized Spark/Databricks workloads, tuning compute and storage to cut pipeline latency and cloud cost.
Developed Data-as-a-Service APIs (Python, FastAPI, Azure Functions) enabling secure, real-time, self-service data access.
Led and mentored a team of data engineers, establishing best practices in data architecture, CI/CD, and code quality.
Data Engineer  |  Mphasis Limited	Apr 2019 – Mar 2022
Canadian National Railway — Logistics & Supply-Chain Optimization
Stack: Apache Spark, Python, Scala, Kafka, YARN, Azure ML, ML, On-Prem & Azure
Migrated on-premises data infrastructure to Azure, building an event-driven, microservices-based architecture with Spark, Kafka, and Azure Machine Learning.
Developed ML forecasting models to optimize shipment delivery predictions and improve supply-chain efficiency.
Built scalable Scala/PySpark pipelines on YARN for large-scale batch and streaming processing.
Recognized with the Best Mentor Award (2021) for upskilling team members and raising overall productivity.

Travelers Insurance — Claims Digitalization
Stack: Hadoop, Python, Apache Spark, Hive, Sqoop, ETL

Built ETL ingestion with Sqoop and Hive supporting claims digitalization, monitoring, and operational support.
Associate Lead Engineer  |  Maveric Systems Limited	Apr 2013 – Jan 2018
Union National Bank (UAE) & SBI General Insurance
Stack: Python, Oracle, Selenium, UFT, JMeter, Java, Maven, DB Testing
Led the T24 core banking upgrade (R07 → R14), ensuring seamless data migration, validation, and reconciliation with minimal business disruption.
Implemented the eBao core insurance solution, introducing automation testing to reduce manual effort and support UAT.
Recognized with the Service Excellence Award (2018) for high-quality delivery and seamless project execution.
